svg.title: NVIDIA backend: 4 of 8 verification stages demonstrated; partial 4K GPU desktop captured; 0 of 4 desktop acceptance gates complete
svg.desc: Four verification stages demonstrated in the lab; guest graphics integration is in progress. A 3840 by 2160 NVIDIA-composed framebuffer contains the shipped Omarchy wallpaper, bar and an actual NVIDIA-rendered Alacritty application surface. Terminal glyph rendering and clean desktop lifetimes still fail, so no complete desktop frame or desktop acceptance gate is accepted. Next: readable GPU application content and clean desktop lifecycle. Checklist counts do not measure engineering effort. Updated October 19, 2026.
svg.text: Captured: 4K GPU wallpaper, Omarchy bar and NVIDIA application surface
Partial frame: application text and clean desktop lifecycle still fail
Next: readable GPU application content and clean desktop lifecycle
Green: demonstrated · Amber: in progress · Gray: pending · Updated 2026-10-19
